description: "Suggestions for the Prevention of Juvenile Depravity" by Benjamin Rotch is a sociopolitical treatise written in the mid-19th century. The book addresses issues surrounding juvenile crime, particularly among the lower classes in urban settings, advocating for preventive measures rather than punitive ones.
